# Reddix

> AI-powered Reddit lead generation platform for SaaS founders, agencies, and growth teams.

Reddix scans Reddit 24/7 to find high-intent leads mentioning your product category. It scores buying intent with AI (0–100), drafts context-aware replies, and tracks leads from discovery to conversion — all on autopilot.

## Core Features

- **AI Intent Detection**: Scores every Reddit thread for buying intent (0–100) using NLP
- **Lead Scoring**: Ranks and prioritizes leads so you focus on real buyers
- **AI Reply Drafts**: Generates natural, context-aware reply suggestions
- **Subreddit Discovery**: AI finds relevant communities you didn't know existed
- **Scheduled Scans**: Autonomous 24/7 scanning on autopilot
- **Deduplication**: Filters duplicate posts so you never waste time
- **Website Analysis**: Extracts product context from your URL for smarter scoring
- **Natural Tone**: Replies match your brand voice (professional, casual, witty, etc.)
- **Analytics Dashboard**: Track leads found, conversion rates, and scan history

## Who It's For

- SaaS Founders — find users actively searching for your category
- Marketing Agencies — scale Reddit lead gen across multiple clients
- Solopreneurs — one-person teams finding warm leads on autopilot
- Developer Tools — reach devs where they actually hang out
- E-commerce Brands — discover product recommendation threads
- B2B Sales Teams — surface enterprise buying signals on Reddit
- Content Marketers — find content gaps and distribution opportunities
- Startup Growth — early traction through authentic Reddit engagement
